landing.heroTitle: Armilla · Zi Wei Dou Shu Chart Casting
landing.heroSub: Enter your birth details to cast your twelve-palace chart. Every star placed by algorithm; every reading traced to the classics.
landing.whatBody: A chart-casting and reading tool: enter a solar or lunar birth date, a server-side engine casts the full twelve-palace chart, with deterministic readings across thirteen dimensions. Same input, same output — auditable end to end.
landing.notBody: Not AI-generated. No fortune verdicts, no event prediction. We present traditional star lore and classical configurations; the judgment stays with you.
landing.palacesBody: The Life Palace is the pivot; eleven others each govern a domain — click any palace to see what it rules.
landing.starsBody: From the sovereign Zi Wei to the general Po Jun: each star's nature and behavior in each palace, entry by entry.
landing.methodBody: The engine, the calendar conversions, the datasets and classical sources — all listed on this page. Every instrument has its scale marks.

method.title: Method & Sources
method.engineBody: Built on the open-source iztro engine (MIT) with lunar-javascript (MIT) for calendar conversion, plus a vendored calibration layer (leap-month mid-split, brightness transformation school, true solar time). Verified against 29 golden test cases.
method.dataBody: Thirteen-dimension readings come verbatim from the Zi Wei Dou Shu Open Interpretation Dataset v4.0 (674,976 charts x 13 dimensions, CC BY 4.0). Source: github.com/Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu, author: WangDuoyu-AI. Configuration detection uses its open pattern library (MIT, classical-first conditions). All in-house copy follows the tone rule: no fortune verdicts.
method.boundaryBody: This site declares no fortunes, predicts no events, and offers no medical or investment advice. Zi Wei Dou Shu is a traditional symbolic system; we present it as it is. Whether to use it, and what to believe, is yours to decide.
method.privacyBody: No accounts, no database, no behavioral tracking. Your birth data lives only in the URL you choose to share and in your own browser (localStorage for recent charts). Payments are processed by Stripe; card data never touches our servers. Purchase records live only with Stripe and your own browser.

terms.title: Terms & Refund Policy
terms.serviceBody: This site provides Zi Wei Dou Shu chart casting and digitized traditional interpretive texts. All readings derive from an open dataset and classical star lore, and are offered for cultural and entertainment reference — not as medical, legal, financial, or relationship advice.
terms.paymentBody: The full report is a one-time purchase (currently $5.99 USD) processed securely by Stripe with international card support. Your purchase code is bound to the purchased birth data, valid forever, and restorable on any device — no account required.
terms.refundBody: Products are instantly delivered digital content; once a purchase code is redeemed, delivery is complete and refunds are generally not offered. If payment succeeded but unlocking fails, or you were charged twice, contact us with your payment receipt for a full refund after verification. Statutory withdrawal rights of EU/UK consumers remain unaffected.
terms.disclaimerBody: Divination content is for cultural reference only; no event prediction, no fortune verdicts. Consult qualified professionals for real-life decisions. Using this service means you understand and accept these boundaries.
